library_preparation_preflight.summary: Published flycapture jar only bundles the JNI shim; it links against libflycapture.so.2/libflycapturevideo.so.2/libmultisync.so.2 (and -c variants) from FLIR's proprietary, EULA-gated SDK, which is not redistributable via Maven or any public Docker image. Any FlyCapture2 class touch will throw UnsatisfiedLinkError at class-init time, with or without a camera attached.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Do not expect the normal testImplementation "org.bytedeco:flycapture:$libraryVersion" + testRuntimeOnly "org.bytedeco:flycapture-platform:$libraryVersion" scaffold to run successfully on its own. Verified via `ldd` on the linux-x86_64 classifier jar that libjniFlyCapture2.so and libjniFlyCapture2_C.so have unresolved NEEDED entries for libflycapture.so.2, libflycapturevideo.so.2, libmultisync.so.2, libflycapture-c.so.2, libflycapturevideo-c.so.2, and libmultisync-c.so.2 — none of which ship in the artifact. These come only from FLIR's licensed FlyCapture SDK installer (per javacpp-presets' own cppbuild.sh, which assumes a manual install under /usr/include/flycapture/ rather than fetching anything). Since Loader.load() runs in a static initializer, simply loading any org.bytedeco.flycapture.FlyCapture2 class fails immediately — there is no reachable code path (not even bus-enumeration calls) that avoids this. There is no env var, system property, or test-code workaround that substitutes for the missing native libraries; the only real fix (installing FLIR's licensed SDK on the test host) falls outside Maven dependencies and Docker images this driver can apply. Expect this to end in human-intervention rather than a passing generated test, and flag it as such rather than iterating on test code when the UnsatisfiedLinkError appears.
risks: FlyCapture's runtime libraries are proprietary and EULA-gated by FLIR; no deterministic_setup (dependency or Docker image) can legally supply them.

This issue is listed as blocking #10687 (javacv:1.5.12) and blocked by #10686 (javacpp:1.5.9) — javacv coverage will inherit the same native-linkage blocker for any FlyCapture2FrameGrabber-related code paths.
